ms.report:
Updates in the Rosen Bridge Github (open-source)- https://github.com/rosen-bridge
・All changes can be visible on the github link above. 

Technical changes and code update
Due to the result of the public test and stress tests, discovered bugs in the codes, security audits, and community feedback, we have made some necessary/optional changes in the code to improve security and performance. As a result, almost all of these changes affected other packages and apps, but we are referring to the main changes here.
Ogmios v6 Update
Reason: update the underlying infrastructure to be more efficient
Major changes:
@rosen-bridge/scanner v3.0.0 
@rosen-bridge/rosen-extractor v3.0.0
Koios v1 Update
Reason: update the underlying infrastructure to be more efficient
Major changes:
@rosen-chains/cardano-koios-network v3.0.0
BlockFrost Cardano API
Reason: Broaden information sources support
Major change:
@rosen-chains/cardano-blockfrost v0.1.0
Update Cardano Token Format
Reason: Utilizing a more general format to be able to work with all Cardano endpoints
Major change:
@rosen-chains/cardano v3.0.0
Fix Tss Signer Bugs
Reason: A missed mutex lock and considering server-side TTL to prevent asynchronous operation
Major change:
@rosen-bridge/tss v1.1.2
@rosen-bridge/tss v1.2.0
Fix Contracts Security Vulnerabilities
Reason: Fixed security vulnerabilities after public review
Major change:
@rosen-bridge/contract 
Fix Scripts Misbehavior
Reason: Fixed contract misbehavior after the latest vulnerability fix
Major change:
@rosen-bridge/contract
Add Locki Log Monitor
Reason: Facilitating service monitoring
Major change:
@rosen-bridge/abstract-logger v1.0.0
UX Improvements and Fixes
Reason: Fixed existing bugs and improved user experience after usage feedback
Major changes:
@rosen-bridge/watcher-app
@rosen-bridge/guard-app
@rosen-bridge/rosen-app
